title: ArneLifesteal
description: Lifesteal+ is a competitive PvP plugin where players gain hearts by killing others and lose hearts on death. With crafting, revive mechanics, withdraw system, and GUI-based settings, it creates a high-stakes survival experience perfect for SMP servers.
body:
# 🩸 Lifesteal+ is a competitive PvP plugin that turns Minecraft into a high-risk, high-reward survival experience.



⚔️ Core Mechanics

• Gain ❤️ hearts by killing players

• Lose 💀 hearts on death

• Reach 0 hearts → 🚫 ban or 👁 spectator mode (configurable)



📦 Features

 • Withdraw system: 
 
 /lifesteal withdraw <amount>
   
 • Custom crafting:
– 

❤️ Heart (8 Diamonds + 1 Enchanted Golden Apple)

– 📖 Revive Book (Gold + Diamonds + Heart)

 • 🔄 Revive GUI to bring players back
 
 • ⚙️ Settings GUI (/lifesteal settings) for in-game configuration


🛠️ Commands

 • /lifesteal give <player> <hearts>
   
 • /lifesteal set <player> <hearts>
   
 • /lifesteal add/remove <player> <hearts>
   
 • /lifesteal revive  <player>
   
 • /lifesteal withdraw <amount>
   
 • /lifesteal reload

## 🚀 Why Lifesteal+ ?
Lightweight, configurable, and optimized for Paper/Spigot 1.21.x, Lifesteal+ delivers intense PvP gameplay perfect for SMPs, servers, and content creators.
